hero.sub: We play online, we play on the table, we film the chaos. Streams, IRL challenges and Catan nights that end friendships — all under one roof.

crew.title: The Crew
crew.sub: Six people, one balaur. Every head has its own main, its own rank and its own moments we're collectively ashamed of.

story.title: A six-headed balaur
story.p1: In Romanian folklore, the balaur is the many-headed creature that guards treasure. Ours guards a lobby: six friends from Romania who met through games and stayed for the chaos.
story.p2: We're not an esports org with offices and contracts. We're the house where people scream at Valorant, trade sheep at Catan and film challenges we regret the next day. Streams, clips, tournaments between us — and soon, with you.

sponsors.title: Partner with the balaur
sponsors.body: We're building a Romanian gaming audience — authentic, engaged and hard to bore. If your brand wants into the lobby, let's talk before the slots fill up.

community.title: Join the community
community.body: The Discord is our living room: stream announcements, challenge polls and the channel where we decide who pays for pizza.
